description:
Prism is the wallpaper app for people who want better-looking phones.

Discover AI wallpapers, 4K wallpapers and AMOLED backgrounds in one place. Browse fresh collections, find your vibe and save the ones you love to Photos in a tap.

Whether you want minimal, abstract, dark, colourful or futuristic wallpapers, Prism helps you find high-quality backgrounds that match your style.

WHY PRISM

• Explore AI wallpapers, 4K wallpapers and AMOLED backgrounds
• Browse curated collections across 30+ categories
• Preview wallpapers on an iPhone lock screen before you save them
• Save favourites, download to Photos and share what you love
• Start browsing straight away, no account needed

WALLPAPERS YOU'LL ACTUALLY WANT TO USE

• 4K wallpapers for crisp, detailed screens
• AMOLED wallpapers for deep blacks
• AI wallpapers generated from your ideas
• Community uploads from wallpaper creators worldwide, reviewed before they go live
• 5 colour variants for every wallpaper
• Search by keyword, colour or tag
• Generate a colour palette from any wallpaper

Save a wallpaper to Photos, then set it from the Photos app or Settings > Wallpaper.

CREATE AI WALLPAPERS

Type a vibe, prompt or visual style and generate a unique AI wallpaper inside Prism. Perfect for a fresh look no one else has.

CURATED COLLECTIONS

• Daily-updated collections
• Wall of the Day, a new pick every morning
• 30+ categories including minimal, abstract, landscapes and colourful

FOR CREATORS

• Upload your wallpapers and build a creator profile
• Follow the artists you like
• Report content or block users at any time

PRISM PRO

Unlock more with Prism Pro, available monthly, yearly or as a one-time lifetime purchase:

• Unlimited downloads with no ads
• Up to 30 AI-generated wallpapers a day
• Exclusive premium collections
• Priority review for your uploads

Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings. Terms of Use: https://prismwalls.com/terms. Privacy Policy: https://prismwalls.com/privacy.
promotionalText: Discover AI, AMOLED & 4K wallpapers. Save your favourites to Photos in a tap.
